caption: The drawing depicts a single black boot viewed from the side and facing to the right. The boot is ankle-high and features a row of brownish buttons running along the side for fastening. The boot has a rounded square toe and a small, thick, brown heel. A large decorative black bow with a gold rectangular buckle is positioned across the top of the shoe near the toe. The interior lining, visible at the top edge, is a beige color. The boot is set against a plain, light tan background, with no additional objects or decorations in the composition. The artist’s name appears faintly at the bottom left corner of the image.
title: Woman's Shoe
